name: insulin receptor

function.text: INSR encodes insulin receptor [Cleaved into: Insulin receptor subunit alpha; Insulin receptor subunit beta]. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and cargo receptor activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Donohue syndrome (autosomal recessive); insulin-resistance syndrome type A (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
